verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting docs say any signal can be evaluated against a threshold or for abnormal behavior. NRQL-based alerts are described as the primary and most powerful alert type, and notifications can route issues to the correct system or team. The pack contains no evidence of grouping or silencing, which are two of the story's four elements. Missing for 10: notification/incident grouping (correlation), silencing/muting of notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration.
